definition.proposition: sm_121 has TMA and block-scaled `mma.sync` (FP4/FP6/FP8) but no `wgmma` and no `tcgen05`/Tensor Memory, so Hopper and datacenter-Blackwell kernels (FlashAttention-3, FA4, tcgen05 CUTLASS/DeepGEMM paths) cannot run; Triton uses `mma.sync`

limitations.text: The cited PTX ISA 9.5 §§9.7.16-9.7.18 covers instruction availability on sm_121a only (mma.sync block-scaled kinds, wgmma sm_90a-only, tcgen05 sm_100a-family). 'Triton uses mma.sync' rests on triton-lang/triton#10331 and 'FA3/FA4/tcgen05 CUTLASS/DeepGEMM paths cannot run' is an inference from those requirements (notes/hardware-spark.md:37-38,57,141); no local probe
